sentences: Jeong Seon was seventy-five when he painted Mount Inwang just after the rain had cleared.
Most painters of his day copied idealized landscapes from Chinese model books, but Jeong perfected 'true-view landscape,' painting the actual mountains of Korea in front of him.
The great rock face that dominates the scroll is built from layer upon layer of dense ink, conveying the weight of granite still dark and glistening with rain.
The white mist rising below it is simply bare paper, left untouched.
That contrast between heavy ink and empty space creates the damp air of a morning after rain.
Look up at Inwangsan from Seoul today and you will be struck by how true it is.
